summary.en-US: YouTube videos pick up where you left off, even when you click a thumbnail after its preview.

description.en-US:
**Two YouTube annoyances, fixed:**

- **On Firefox, clicking a video you were previewing restarts it at 0:00.** In Chrome, when you hover a thumbnail, let the preview play and click it, the full video continues from the preview. In Firefox and Firefox-based browsers YouTube throws that position away, even when you're signed in. This add-on remembers the preview's position and continues from there, like Chrome.
- **You close a video halfway and it starts over next time.** YouTube only remembers your position when you're signed in with watch history on. This add-on remembers it in your browser, signed in or not.

**It stays out of your way**

- Timestamp links (`&t=…`) are respected: your saved position is only used when a video would start from the beginning.
- Ads, live streams, Shorts and videos under a minute are ignored.
- Finished videos are forgotten, so they start fresh next time.
- Works in YouTube videos embedded on other sites too.

**One setting**

How long a position is kept if you don't come back to the video: 7, 15 (default), 30, 60 or 90 days. Click the add-on's button in the extensions menu to change it.

**Privacy**

Only the "storage" permission. It saves the video ID, the position and the date, in your browser only. Nothing is sent anywhere: no analytics, no account, no remote code.

**Lightweight**

No background page and no timers: it only listens to the video player's own events, and saves every few seconds while you watch.
